column1: # bench-models.tsv — model price ASSUMPTIONS for the cost axis of the Pareto bench.
# These are PUBLIC LIST PRICES, per million tokens (USD), and they are an ESTIMATE: real billing
# depends on the plan (a Max subscription bills nothing per token via OAuth — see eval/lib.sh
# billing-safety note), on cache hits, and on the actual token counts a task consumes. The bench
# uses these numbers only to turn measured token counts into a comparable cost-per-task figure.
# The frontier shifts every few weeks (the whole point of the Uber method) — revise this table,
# do not trust it as fixed. Override the whole file with RDA_BENCH_MODELS=/path/to/table.tsv.
# Columns (TAB-separated): model_id  input_usd_per_mtok  output_usd_per_mtok
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored. Only these 3 columns are read — the
# parser (eval/bench-run.sh aggregate_and_pareto) takes column[0..2] and ignores the rest, but
# the DOCUMENTED format stays 3 columns; a Copilot premium multiplier or a cache price does not
# fit it, so both are recorded here as comments instead of a silent 4th column.
# The `claude-opus`/`claude-sonnet`/`claude-haiku` rows below are the ORIGINAL generic-family
# rows: eval/test-model-bench.sh asserts on them by name in its committed-fixture check — do not
# rename or remove them. The rows added 2026-09-24 use the current concrete registry ids instead.
claude-opus
claude-sonnet
claude-haiku
# Added 2026-09-24 (Roberto, explicit promotion) — public list prices, per registry id, USD/MTok:
#   cache-read prices (not a column here): opus-5.5 $0.20, gpt-6-astra $1.00
#   cache prices (sonnet-5 only, not a column here): cache read $0.20, cache write $2.50
#   gpt-6-astra: >272k input tokens DOUBLES the input/output prices below (not modeled here)
#   Copilot premium multipliers observed (not a column here): Opus 15x, Astra 1x, Sonnet 1x
claude-opus-5.5
claude-sonnet-5
claude-haiku-4.5
claude-fable-5.1
gpt-6-astra
